event_exchange_end.name: event_exchange_end
event_exchange_end.value: ("event_exchanges"."status" IN ('pending','accepted') AND "event_exchanges"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "event_exchanges"."end_reason" IS NULL) OR ("event_exchanges"."status" NOT IN ('pending','accepted') AND "event_exchanges"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "event_exchanges"."end_reason" IN ('declined','cancelled','revoked','expired','unavailable'))

event_photo_storage.name: event_photo_storage
event_photo_storage.value: ("event_photos"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "event_photos"."photo_key" IS NOT NULL) OR ("event_photos"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "event_photos"."photo_key" IS NULL)

event_social_participants.name: event_social_participants
event_social_participants.value: "event_social_pairs"."status" = 'blocked' OR ("event_social_pairs"."greeting_id" IS NOT NULL AND "event_social_pairs"."room_id" IS NOT NULL AND "event_social_pairs"."sender_id" IS NOT NULL AND "event_social_pairs"."recipient_id" IS NOT NULL AND (("event_social_pairs"."sender_id" = "event_social_pairs"."low_id" AND "event_social_pairs"."recipient_id" = "event_social_pairs"."high_id") OR ("event_social_pairs"."sender_id" = "event_social_pairs"."high_id" AND "event_social_pairs"."recipient_id" = "event_social_pairs"."low_id")))

event_worldcup_winner.name: event_worldcup_winner
event_worldcup_winner.value: winner_id IS NULL OR winner_id IN (left_id,right_id)

event_corner_photo_reference.name: event_corner_photo_reference
event_corner_photo_reference.value: (photo_id IS NULL AND photo_revision IS NULL) OR (photo_id IS NOT NULL AND photo_revision>=1)

event_activity_room.name: event_activity_room
event_activity_room.value: (status='linked' AND room_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status!='linked' AND room_id IS NULL)
